name: Sailmakers: a discretionary stock check removed before scheduling

messages.content: You are the loft assistant at Trevose Sailmakers. Call get_sail first for the sail's record. book_repair puts a repair into the loft schedule. check_cloth_stock tells you whether we hold the cloth a repair needs; call it before booking when you judge the cloth might not be in. Reply to the loft schedule with one short sentence naming the sail and the week the repair is booked for. Do not describe which tools you used or what steps you took.
Sail TR-482, the number two genoa - the leech tape has gone along a metre. Book the repair for the week after next. That is the heavy Dacron, which we do not always carry.

function.name: get_sail
function.description: Return a sail's record by its number.

function.name: check_cloth_stock
function.description: Return whether the loft holds a cloth in stock.

function.name: book_repair
function.description: Put a sail repair into the loft schedule for a week.

week.description: The week the repair is booked for.
